in_sanskrit.name: Prājñāktā
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has knowledge, understanding, and wisdom.

in_hindi.name: प्राज्ञाक्ता
in_hindi.meaning: प्राज्ञ (Prājñ): Wisdom, Intelligent, Knowledgeable क्ता (ktā): One who has
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who possesses wisdom, knowledge, and understanding.

in_tamil.name: ப்ராஜ்ஞாக்தா
in_tamil.meaning: ப்ராஜ்ஞ (prājñ): விஜ்யா (vi-jyā): Wisdom, Intelligent, Knowledgeable க்தா (ktā): One who has
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has the ability to discern, understand, and acquire knowledge.

in_telugu.name: ప్రాజ్ఞక్తా
in_telugu.meaning: ప్రాజ్ఞ (prājñ): దేశి (deśi): Wisdom, Intelligent, Knowledgeable క్తా (ktā): One who has
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has the wisdom, knowledge, and understanding.

in_marathi.name: Prajakta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prajakta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit words ‘praj’ (progress, advancement) and ‘akta’ (doer). The name signifies the one who makes progress or the one who initiates and executes a task.

in_bengali.name: Prajakta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Progress, Advancement
in_bengali.long_meaning: Prajakta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। From the Sanskrit words ‘praj’ (progress, advancement) and ‘akta’ (doer). The name signifies the one who makes progress or the one who initiates and executes a task.
